newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chilgener started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chilgener started as buy.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it has started coverage of Chilean power company Chilgener SA with a rating of buy.

-- "Chile's second-largest electric generator is well positioned to become one of the leading energy companies in South America," analysts Sonia Olinto and Daniele Seitz wrote in a report released on Friday.
-- "Aiming to increase its leadership status in the region, the company plans to continue acquiring key assets in Latin America."
-- "... Based only on the plants in construction and advanced development, we estimate (company) growth in earnings on operations at 12 percent a year.
-- "However, this figure could be conservative, since its cash flow could allow at least one major project in each of the next five years."
-- Chilgener sells at 12 times estimated 1997 earnings and 11 times its 1998 estimated earnings, a valuation the analysts called "modest."
